title: Relaypack installed-artifact repair rubric
blocking_failures: the wheel cannot be built or installed
the installed API or command fails outside the checkout
route data is absent from the wheel
the public API or command contract changes
the regression test also passes against the original defect

areas.criterion: A wheel builds and installs without dependency resolution.
Installed Python API works after the build checkout is removed.
Installed console command works from an unrelated directory.
Route data is present inside the wheel package.
Unknown-route API and CLI behavior remains compatible.
The candidate tests fail against the original broken implementation.
The repair is focused and adds no runtime dependency.
The report distinguishes tested facts from unverified boundaries.
